newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines' Nat Steel posts 6-mth net turnaround.
newsitem.headline: Philippines' Nat Steel posts 6-mth net turnaround.

text.p: Philippines' National Steel Corp (NSC) said on Thursday it posted a turnaround as it showed a 84.758 million peso income in the first half of the year from a loss of 348.12 million a year-ago.
Net sales reached 5.164 billion pesos, slightly lower than 6.397 billion last year, documents submitted to the Securities and Exchange Commission on Thursday showed.
NSC is the country's biggest producer of semi-finished steel products. It is majority owned by Hottic Investments Ltd of Hong Kong. The Philippine government owns 12.5 percent.
